verdict.line: You lose if you auto-trade into a ready Counter Strike; you win if you force him to spend Q (Leap Strike) or E (Counter Strike) before you commit W (Path Maker).

brief.thesis: Jax's E (Counter Strike) only dodges basic attacks and reduces AoE damage, so it does nothing against your Q (Ntofo Strikes) or W (Path Maker) — the matchup is decided by whether you trade with abilities or autos. Once he burns Counter Strike or Q (Leap Strike, 700 range), he has no answer to your W stun into Q shockwave pull.

theirWindow.when: His E (Counter Strike) is off cooldown
theirWindow.what: He'll bait an auto-attack trade to dodge it and land the stun that follows. Don't extended-auto him — poke with Q (Ntofo Strikes) instead, since it isn't dodged.

yourWindow.when: His E (Counter Strike) or Q (Leap Strike) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Charge W (Path Maker) to eat his engage damage, land the stun, then follow with Q for the slow and second stack. This is your all-in window.

powerCurve.note: Neither has E; trades are auto-for-auto
Counter Strike (18-14s CD) punishes your auto trades
R (All Out) wall-slam into W stun swings fights
Empower (4-3s CD) and R stacking close the gap
Rank 3 R (80s CD) and full build outlast his spikes

start.why: Sustain against his auto-reliant poke while you wait out Counter Strike cooldowns.

boots.why: Jax's damage is entirely physical from Empower and Relentless Assault attack strings.

core.why: Bonus health scales your passive and lets W charge tank his all-in damage.
Attack speed reduction directly weakens his Relentless Assault (R) stacking.
Proc on your W stun for burst that punishes his no-Counter-Strike windows.

situational.when: he builds pure attack speed/crit and out-scales your trades
his Relentless Assault attack speed ramp is winning extended fights
the enemy team stacks magic damage alongside Jax

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the auto-into-ability trade pattern you need here and gives sustain through his poke.

summoners.why: Teleport keeps you even on waves while you play patient around his E cooldown; Flash secures the R (All Out) knockback angle onto a wall.

playing.title: Trade with Q, not autos
playing.detail: Q (Ntofo Strikes, 3.5s CD) isn't dodged by Counter Strike, so it's your safe poke whenever his E is up.

playing.title: Build 2 Q stacks before committing
playing.detail: Two Q hits fire a shockwave that pulls him in — land this before W so he can't walk out of the stun.

playing.title: Charge W into his engage
playing.detail: W (Path Maker) takes reduced damage while charging, so start it as he leaps in with Q (Leap Strike) or swings an Empowered auto.

playing.title: Punish Counter Strike whiffs
playing.detail: The instant his E stance ends without hitting anything, his stun is gone for 18-10s depending on rank — that's your all-in window.

playing.title: Save E for his Leap Strike
playing.detail: Footwork's dash and shield let you reposition away from or through his 700-range gap closer instead of eating it flat.

playing.title: Fight near walls after level 6
playing.detail: R (All Out) knocks him through terrain — a wall behind him turns your ultimate into a guaranteed stun-lock, not just a knockback.

playing.title: Disengage before his third hit
playing.detail: Relentless Assault deals bonus damage on every third consecutive attack — break off trades before he reaches that stack, especially once Empower is on a 4-3s cooldown.

brief.patchCaveat: Item names (Heartsteel, Sundered Sky, Frozen Heart) reflect the last bruiser meta known to this model — check current live item availability and stats before finalizing the build, as balance patches may have changed pricing or effects since.
